info.title: Daily Brief API
info.summary: Contract shared by the web app, the future iOS app, and the agent worker.
info.description:
Single contract for the Daily Brief backend. Client types are generated from this file.

Full URLs are `/api/v1/...` (public), `/api/health`, and `/api/internal/...` (worker only).

**Authentication.** Every `/v1` route requires a user JWT (`userJwt`) issued by the identity
provider. Every `/internal` route requires the service token in the `X-Internal-Token` header
(`internalToken`). Internal routes do not accept a user JWT, and `/v1` routes do not accept the
internal token. `/health` is unauthenticated.

**Registration gate.** A profile has `status` of `pending`, `active` or `disabled`. On first
sign-in the backend creates a profile: `active` if the email is on the allowlist, otherwise
`pending`. A `pending` account may call only `GET /v1/me` and `POST /v1/auth/redeem-invite`;
every other `/v1` route returns 403 with code `account_pending`. A `disabled` account gets
403 with code `account_disabled` on every `/v1` route, including `GET /v1/me`.

**Errors.** All errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` (`Problem`) with a
machine-readable `code`.

servers.description: Same origin as the frontend; routed to the API.

tags.name: subscriptions
tags.description: Topic subscriptions, item counts and order.

tags.name: marks
tags.description: Read state and notes on items.

tags.name: jobs
tags.description: On-demand brief generation ("Generate now") and its status.

get.description: Returns only status ok, no data. No authentication.
Allowed for `pending` accounts. Creates the profile on first sign-in.

post.description: Moves a `pending` account to `active`. Allowed for `pending` accounts.

post.summary: Subscribe to an existing topic or a new topic title
post.description: Send either `topic_id` or `title` (creates a private topic). Duplicate returns 409 `already_subscribed`.

patch.summary: Update item count, order or enabled flag

200.description: Slots and the timezone they are interpreted in.

put.summary: Replace the full set of delivery slots
put.description:
Replaces all slots. More than 3 returns 422 `slot_limit_exceeded`; duplicate
`local_time` values return 422 (`duplicate_slot`). Positions are assigned by array order.

get.summary: List the caller's reports for a date

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Report date. Defaults to today in the caller's timezone.

get.summary: Get one report with sections, items and the caller's marks
get.description: Only the caller's own reports; others return 404.

put.summary: Set read state and note on an item
put.description: Notes are plain text and must always be rendered as plain text.

get.summary: Get agent settings (display only in the POC)

patch.summary: Update agent settings (reserved in the POC)
patch.description:
Defined for forward compatibility. In the POC every field is reserved: the API rejects
any change with 403 code `agent_settings_locked`.

200.description: Updated settings (not reachable in the POC).

403.description:
Code `agent_settings_locked` (every change in the POC), or an account-state error
(`account_pending`, `account_disabled`).

post.summary: Queue a brief for the caller now ("Generate now")
post.description:
Creates one on-demand job for the caller (`slot_id` null, `scheduled_for` = now) with the runner
from the caller's agent settings, commits it, then dispatches the worker. No request body.
- Counts toward `daily_run_limit`, together with scheduled jobs, in the same day window the
  scheduler uses (the caller's timezone). Over the limit: 429 `daily_limit_reached`.
- At most one `queued` or `running` job per user, checked atomically: otherwise 409 `job_in_progress`.
- The caller needs at least one enabled subscription: otherwise 422 `no_topics`.
- Runner `claude_subscription` and the caller is not the configured owner: 403 `owner_only`,
  and no job is created (DESIGN 3.1).
- A dispatch failure does not fail the request: the job stays `queued` and the next scheduler
  tick dispatches it again.

429.description: `daily_limit_reached` (no `Retry-After`; try again the next day) or `rate_limited`.

get.summary: Status of one of the caller's jobs
get.description: For polling after `generateNow`. Another user's job is 404.

post.summary: Worker claims the next queued job
post.description:
Authenticated with `X-Internal-Token` only; a user JWT is rejected with 401.
Marks the job `running` and increments `attempts`.

200.description: A claimed job and its request.

post.description:
Authenticated with `X-Internal-Token` only. In one transaction the API stores the report,
sections, items and usage and marks the job `succeeded`.
409 `lease_lost` if the job is not `running` or `attempt` does not match;
422 if the body fails the BriefResult schema, or 422 `invalid_rank` if item ranks in a section
are not exactly 1..n in array order. Sections are validated against topics owned by the job's
user (not the user's current subscriptions), so settings edited mid-run do not reject output.

Authenticated with `X-Internal-Token` only. If `retryable` and attempts remain, the job
returns to `queued`; otherwise it becomes `failed`. 409 `lease_lost` if `attempt` does not match.

userJwt.description: JWT from the identity provider. Accepted on `/v1` routes only.

internalToken.name: X-Internal-Token
internalToken.description: Service token for the worker. Accepted on `/internal` routes only.

Attempt.name: attempt
Attempt.description:
Lease fencing. The `job.attempts` value returned by `POST /internal/jobs/claim`. The API accepts
the call only while the job is `running` with exactly this attempt number; otherwise 409 `lease_lost`
(the lease expired and the job was re-queued or re-claimed).

ForbiddenAccount.description:
Account gate. Code `account_pending` (profile is pending and the route is not
`GET /v1/me` or `POST /v1/auth/redeem-invite`) or `account_disabled`.

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not owned by the caller (code `not_found`).

Unprocessable.description:
Validation failed (code `validation_error`, or a specific code such as
`slot_limit_exceeded`, `duplicate_slot`, `visibility_not_supported`).

SubscriptionCreate.description: Either an existing `topic_id` or a new topic `title`.

slots.description: Full replacement set. `local_time` values must be unique.

timezone.description: IANA zone the slots are interpreted in.

mark.description: The caller's mark, or null if none.

AgentSettingsUpdate.description: All fields are reserved in the POC; any change returns 403 `agent_settings_locked`.

UserJob.description: A job as its owner sees it. Never includes worker output, prompts or raw errors.

error_code.description: Short code when `status` is `failed`, e.g. `worker_failed`, `owner_only`. Never free text.

BriefResult.title: BriefResult
BriefResult.description: Output of an AgentRunner for one BriefRequest. The worker validates it before posting to /internal/jobs/{job_id}/result; the API validates it again.

note.description: Used when status is insufficient_news or when sources disagree (for example on a number).

items.description: Ordered by importance. Each item's rank equals its 1-based position (enforced by prefixItems).

Section.$comment: status ok requires at least one item; insufficient_news may have zero items (never pad).

rank.description: Equals the item's 1-based position in the section's items array.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences in the agent's own words.

source_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL with a non-empty host, actually found by the agent.
